items.title: modDevTools
items.text: This MODX Extra adds some nice development features to the MODX manager. It allows you to search and replace text in the content of chunks and templates. It is possible to edit linked (used) chunks, templates, snippets and resources in the chunk, snippet, template edit page. A breadcrumb path is shown on the resource edit page.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• MODX Revolution 2.6+
  • PHP 7.2+

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Custom Manager Page for search and replace text in the content of chunks and templates, with wildcards, regular expressions and a preview of the replacements
  • Additional tabs in the chunk, snippet, template edit page
  • Linked breadcrumb path on the resource edit page

items.title: Install from MODX Extras
items.text: Search for modDevTools in the Package Manager of a MODX installation and install it in there.

items.title: Manual installation
items.text:
If you can't access the MODX Extras Repository in your MODX installation, you can manually install modDevTools.

  • Download the transport package from MODX Extras (or one of the pre built transport packages in _packages)
  • Upload the zip file to your MODX installation's core/packages folder or upload it manually in the MODX Package Manager.
  • In the MODX Manager, navigate to the Package Manager page, and select 'Search locally for packages' from the dropdown button.
  • modDevTools should now show up in the list of available packages. Click the corresponding 'Install' button and follow the instructions to complete the installation.

items.title: Build it from source
items.text: To build and install the package from source you could use Git Package Management. The GitHub repository of modDevTools contains a config.json to build that package locally. Use this option, if you want to debug modDevTools and/or contribute bugfixes and enhancements.

items.title: Introduction
items.text: This MODX Extra adds some nice development features to the MODX manager.

items.title: Search and replace
items.text:
The Extras menu contains a new entry modDevTools, which opens a separate manager page. It allows you to search and replace text in the contents of chunks and templates.

Enter the text you want to search for and click the Search button. Below the search field there are checkboxes to limit the search to specific elements (chunks and templates). Static elements are searched in the current content of their file, even if it was changed outside of MODX, and replacements are written to that file.

items.title: Search options
items.text:
Option Description Plain text The search text is searched literally. This is the default. Wildcards * matches any text within a line and ? any single character, e.g. tpl*Row or Pre?s. Regular expression The search text is a PCRE regular expression without delimiters, e.g. &limit=`(\d+)`. ^ and $ match at line ends. Ignore case Plain text only: ignores upper and lower case. Without this option the search is case-sensitive. Whole words only Plain text only: finds the search text only, if it isn't part of a longer word.

A wildcard * matches as little text as possible. Put some text after it, since a trailing * matches nothing: tpl* only finds tpl.

The wildcard and regular expression searches are always case-sensitive (a regular expression can start with (?i) to ignore the case and use \b for word boundaries).

In the regular expression mode the replacement can contain the matched groups as $1, ${1} or \1 ($0 is the whole match) and \n or \t for a new line or a tab. In the other modes the replacement is used literally. A search text that can match an empty text (e.g. a*) or an invalid regular expression is rejected.

items.title: Replace
items.text:
After a successful search, the code of all found elements is displayed, with the search text highlighted and the number of matches in the title. For each found element there are four buttons below the code block: Replace, Replace all, Skip and Preview.

The Replace button replaces the match at the position where the cursor is located (dark highlighting) with the replacement and moves the cursor to the next match. The Skip button only moves the cursor to the next match, without changing the element. The Replace All button replaces all matches in the code of the current element.

The Preview button opens a window with a list of all matches (up to 500) of the element, showing the text that is removed (red) and the replacement (green) in its line. All matches are selected at first. Untick the matches you don't want to change and click Replace selected. If the element was changed after the preview was created, nothing is replaced and you have to search again.

There are also two other buttons on the right side below the code element: Update and Quick Update. When you click the Update button, the element's edit page opens. Clicking the Quick Update button opens a modal window where you can quickly edit the element.

items.title: Refresh the element links
items.text:
The additional tabs on the element pages are filled from a table of the links between chunks, snippets, templates and resources. The links are updated, when a chunk, template or resource is saved, and they are created for all elements during the installation of the package.

If elements were changed in another way, e.g. in static files, by an import or directly in the database, use the Refresh tab of the custom manager page. Select whether the links of chunks, templates and resources should be recreated and click the Refresh button.

items.title: Edit linked elements
items.text: The editing page of chunks, snippets and templates contains some additional tabs. These tabs allow you to edit the content of linked (used) elements on the current page. The following element pages contain the tabs listed below.

items.title: Chunk Page
items.text:
• Templates Tab - The code of templates in which the currently edited chunk is called. If you have installed Ace, the chunk is highlighted in the template code.
  • Chunks Tab - The code of chunks that are called in the currently edited chunk. Snippet parameters specified in the call and default snippet parameters related to chunks also appear here.
  • Snippets Tab - The code of snippets that are called in the currently edited chunk. Below the snippet code you can expand the snippet properties with default values and descriptions.
  • Resources Tab - List of resources that are included in the template or whose content is called in some way in this chunk. You can go to the edited resource, open it in the browser, quickly change the template or publishing status or move it to the trash.

items.title: Template Page
items.text:
• Chunks Tab - The code of chunks that are called in the currently edited template.
  • Snippets Tab - The code of snippets that are called in the currently edited template.
  • Resources Tab - A list of resources with the currently edited template.

items.title: Snippet Page
items.text: • Resources Tab - A list of resources where the currently edited snippet is called.

items.title: Template edit link
items.text: On the Edit Resources page, an edit icon next to the template field opens the edit page of the selected template.

items.title: Linked Breadcrumb Path
items.text: On the Edit Resources page, a linked breadcrumb path is inserted below the page title. You can click any section of this breadcrumb path to edit the clicked resource. There are two system settings for changing parts of this breadcrumb path. This breadcrumb path is not shown in MODX 3.x, since this version has its own breadcrumb path.

items.title: User permissions
items.text:
modDevTools uses standard user access permissions:

Permission Description view_chunk & view_template To open the custom manager page and search in chunks and templates. save_chunk For changing strings in chunks in the Chunks Tab and for string replacement in chunks on the search page. save_snippet For changing strings in snippets in the Snippets Tab. save_template For changing strings in templates in the Templates Tab and for string replacement in templates on the search page. view_chunk To display the Chunks Tab. view_template To display the Templates Tab. view_snippet To display the Snippets Tab. view_document To display the Resources Tab. edit_document To display an edit icon in the table on the Resources Tab. save_document To change the template of a resource in the table on the Resources Tab. publish_document To change the publication status in the table on the Resources Tab. delete_document To move a resource to the trash in the table on the Resources Tab. edit_template To display the template edit icon on the Edit Resources page. system_perform_maintenance_tasks To refresh the element links in the Refresh tab. settings or moddevtools_settings To display the system settings tab of the custom manager page.

Attention: resource groups are currently not supported, i.e. if a resource group is hidden from site managers in the mgr context, they can still see its resources in the resource list.

items.title: System Settings
items.text:
modDevTools uses the following system settings in the moddevtools namespace and shows them in an additional tab on the custom manager page:

Key Name Description Default moddevtools.breadcrumb_limit Breadcrumb Limit Limit of displayed breadcrumb entries. 3 moddevtools.debug Debug Log debug information in the MODX error log. No moddevtools.show_breadcrumb_context Show Breadcrumb Context Show the context key in the breadcrumb path. No
